definitions.meaning: A hostile army, an army that is carrying on hostilities

quotations.old_english: Com se ungemetlíca unfriðhere tó Sandwíc
On ðissum geáre wæs ðet gafol gelǽst ðam unfriðehere

source_text: unfriþ-here, es; m. A hostile army, an army that is carrying on hostilities :-- Com se ungemetlíca unfriðhere tó Sandwíc, Chr. 1009; Erl. 142, 16. On ðissum geáre wæs ðet gafol gelǽst ðam unfriðehere, 1007; Erl. 141, 13.
